newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil to post $16.4 mln pretax gain.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil to post $16.4 mln pretax gain.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said Thursday it expects to report net pre-tax transaction gains of $16.4 million in the first quarter.
The gains were realized on the sale of certain investment securities and property interests during the quarter, the company said.
The largest of the gains, $11.7 million, resulted from the sales of 4.5 million shares of Cairn Energy Plc, or 27 percent of its holdings in Cairn. Net proceeds were $39.2 million, the company said.
Snyder said it continues to hold 11.7 million shares of Cairn with a current market value of about $109 million.
Other first quarter gains totaling $4.7 million resulted from the completion of 1996 disposition efforts, Snyder said.
